name: Smith Machine Vertical Leg Press
steps: Use a Smith machine equipped for vertical leg presses and set the safety stops above your torso.
Lie beneath its footplate and place both feet flat against it, about hip-width apart.
Release the catches using the machine’s leg-press mechanism, then bend your knees while keeping your pelvis on the floor.
Press the footplate up without snapping your knees straight, then engage the catches before removing your feet.
tips: Check that the stops limit the descent before getting under the footplate.
Keep your feet centered and your knees aligned with your toes.
